items.title: Threat Actors Using Malicious VSCode Extension to Deploy Anivia Loader and OctoRAT
items.description: A fake Visual Studio Code extension has been used in a supply chain attack that targets developers through their editor. The rogue extension, named prettier-vscode-plus and posing as the trusted Prettier formatter, appeared briefly in the official VSCode Marketplace before takedown.
